items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: you were there with Lucky Gay from Milwaukee

ctx.x: Was Elvin on the scene then...?

No, he was a little baby then. But they were in the band and that's how we went to Cincinatti. That's the first time I ever heard Howard McGhee. He came down from Milwaukee with Leonard Gay's band and...Leonard Gay played nice tenor...but Howard was outstanding. He was playing, I'll never forget, his feature was "Body and Soul" and he was playin' like Roy Eldrige at the time. And last time I was in New York, I was on the radio, and he called in and I took him on back, you know. He says, "you start talkin' about…
your feature was 'Body and Soul*', I says, "I wasn't but 16, but you were grown." I says, "But Maggie I'm just playin' with you."
